name: Datafast
_note: datafa.st, as a package. The vendor ships a browser script, so the browser lane loads it and calls its real API: that script also does the things only a document can do (pageviews on history changes, data-fast-goal click targets, scroll goals, outbound-link tracking, bot detection), and reimplementing those badly would be worse than loading them. A phone has no document, so the native lanes speak the ingest protocol directly - the same POST to the same endpoint, with the same visitor and session identity persisted across launches. Same four actions everywhere.

web._note: web/index.js IS the lane, found by file presence. `boot` is not a formality: the vendor script counts a pageview when it loads, so a facet that registered on first CALL would miss the visit entirely on a page nobody clicks.

ready._note: A website id is configured and events will be accepted.

visitorId._note: The datafa.st visitor id, stable for a year. Empty until the first event on a lane that owns it.

sessionId._note: The current session, which rolls over after 30 minutes idle.

lastStatus._note: The HTTP status of the last native send. 0 before the first one, or when the request never completed. Exists because a rejected beacon is otherwise invisible: the endpoint screens callers before it looks the website id up, so a missing header reads as silence rather than an error.

goal._note: A custom event. datafa.st caps custom data at 10 keys; a key is lowercase a-z, 0-9, _ or -, up to 32 characters; a value is stringified and truncated to 255. The same rules are applied on every lane so a goal that lands on web lands on a phone.

tests.name: refuses a goal with no name

pageview._note: One pageview. The browser lane leaves this to the vendor script, which already fires on history changes and throttles a repeat of the same URL within a minute; the native lanes send it and apply the same throttle.

identify._note: Bind the visitor to a known person. datafa.st requires a user_id and refuses the event without one.

payment._note: A payment, attributed to the visitor. datafa.st requires an email and refuses the event without one.
